name: Torrijo de la Cañada (Spain)
description: Blue field with two white wavy stripes across the fly, charged at the hoist with a yellow castle bearing a small shield of the bars of Aragon.
history: Municipal flag of Torrijo de la Cañada; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
